A.notes: Warm green/Fraunces look is attractive but conventional. Fails contrast (Pending 3.58:1), 324px overflow at 390 (screenshot 714 wide), invisible focus on sidebar links, 11px chart text. KPI sparklines crowd the delta text at 1440 (Orders card collides). Mobile table is cramped with wrapped order IDs. Uniform low-stock bars, 6 radii.

B.notes: Plum accent with mono second voice; annotated peak on chart, segmented stock meters with days-of-cover, status chips with icons, filter counts, export/refresh actions, hamburger nav on mobile. Mobile table drops columns (Status/Total clipped or scrolls). Five hue families but each semantic. Few visible motion states.

why: B passes all gates and has richer, more usable detail (annotated peak, days-of-cover stock meters, counted filters, real deltas including negative). A fails contrast, mobile overflow and focus visibility, and its KPI cards are crowded.
